answer: Each agent stakes 70 credits on a heartbeat beacon on the orchard ledge. Each epoch the beacon flashes at a random hour; the agent must answer with a seed-tied heartbeat, or lose 12 credits; two misses burn the bond. The voyage log stays public for replay. First beacon costs 40; the k-th pays 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, locking 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. A rented heartbeat fails replay. An honest agent pays 40 once.
